description: Return the published reader comments on one chapter of a Mike Fluff Press book: who wrote, the quoted passage, the text, replies (parentId), likes, and a link to the place in the chapter. Comments by the author are marked. Open for chapters the caller may read: free chapters to anybody; the rest to a signed-in owner of the chapter, or, for a free book, to a person with a confirmed email (send their token). Book slugs and chapter ids: list_books. Read-only.

locale.description: Edition of the book: each language has its own discussion. en, ru, pt or es.

name: get_chapter_discussion
title: Read a chapter's discussion
